test_title: PYST 33: SSC CGL 2023 - English (Held On: 26 Jul 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question: Select the sentence that contains no spelling errors.

options.text: The childrens playing in the kindergarden allmost broke the window of the principal’s car.
The children playing in the kindergarten almost broke the window of the principal’s car.
The childrens playing in the kindergarten almost broke the window of the principal’s car.
The children playing in the kindergarden allmost broke the window of the principle’s car.

solution:
The correct option is: **The children playing in the kindergarten almost broke the window of the principal’s car.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Children"** is the correct plural form of "child." 
 
• **"Kindergarten"** is the correct spelling for the preschool educational approach. 
 
• **"Almost" i**s correctly spelled, meaning nearly or very close to. 
 
• **"Principal's"** is the correct possessive form of "principal," referring to something that belongs to the principal.
 
• ​Therefore, the correct answer is **'option 2'.**

​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **"childrens" **is incorrect because "children" is already the plural form of "child."
 
• **"Kindergarden"** in Options 1 and 4 is misspelled; the correct spelling is "kindergarten."
 
• **"Allmost" **in Options 1 and 4 is misspelled; the correct spelling is "almost."
 
• **"Principle's"** in Option 4 is incorrect; the correct possessive form for the head of a school is "principal’s." 
 
• Option 2 is the only sentence without any spelling errors.
